title: ucci: reference implementation of UCCI (Calibrated Uncertainty for Cost-Optimal LLM Cascade Routing)
description:
Reference implementation of UCCI (Varun Kotte, arXiv:2605.18796, 2026), a calibration-first router for two-model LLM cascades. It maps the small model's token-margin uncertainty to a per-query error probability by isotonic regression and escalates to the large model when that probability exceeds the threshold selected by constrained cost minimization on validation data.

The package provides the core method (numpy only), serving adapters for OpenAI-compatible APIs, vLLM, Hugging Face transformers and llama.cpp, the paper's baselines and evaluation protocol, a command line tool, a Rust crate with bit-identical results on shared golden vectors, and a public replication on CoNLL-2003.
